title: Operators
description:
Complete the methods:

```csharp
public static bool IsLeapYear(int year)        // divisible by 4, except centuries, except every 400 years
public static string Clock(int minutes)        // minutes after midnight as "h:mm": 125 is "2:05"
public static int Change(int cents, int coin)  // how many coins of that size fit into cents
public static bool CanVote(int age, bool isCitizen, bool isRegistered)
```

- `Clock` wraps around the day: 1440 minutes is `"0:00"` again, and negative minutes count back from midnight (`-30` is `"23:30"`).
- `CanVote` is true for citizens aged 18 or over who are registered.
hints: In C#, `-30 % 1440` is `-30`. Adding 1440 and taking `% 1440` again gives a value from 0 to 1439 for any input.
`{value:D2}` pads a whole number to 2 digits: `5` becomes `05`.
